title: Caplin Point's Unit Gets Colombia's INVIMA GMP Compliance Nod for Oncology Drugs

contentHtml:
Chennai: Caplin Point Laboratories Limited has announced that its subsidiary, Caplin One Labs Limited (COL), has received confirmation of compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) from Colombia's national regulatory authority, INVIMA (Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos), for the manufacture of specified oncology drug products.

The GMP compliance confirmation relates to the manufacturing facility of Caplin One Labs located at Survey No. 499/-, 88/-, 500/-, 89/1, Plot No. G-44, G-45 & G-46, Block A and Block B, SIDCO Industrial Estate, Kakkalur, Tiruvallur District, Tamil Nadu, India.

According to the company, the confirmation was issued by INVIMA, the National Institute for the Surveillance of Food and Drugs and the regulatory authority designated by the Ministry of Health and Social Protection of the Republic of Colombia. INVIMA concluded that the Caplin One Labs manufacturing facility complies with GMP requirements for the production of specified oncology drug products.

The products covered under the compliance confirmation include both sterile and non-sterile dosage forms. The sterile category covers lyophilized powder for injection in vials, while the non-sterile category includes coated and uncoated tablets and hard capsules.

The company stated that the formal GMP certificate from INVIMA is expected to be received in due course. The communication was submitted to the stock exchanges for their information and records, with the company requesting acknowledgement of its receipt.

The GMP compliance confirmation represents a regulatory development for Caplin One Labs' Tamil Nadu manufacturing facility, particularly in relation to its ability to manufacture the specified oncology formulations in accordance with the GMP requirements recognised by Colombia's medicines regulatory authority.
